slides.title: Your habit app is lying to you about *Tuesday*.
slides.alt: Cover card: your habit app is lying to you about Tuesday.

slides.text:
Lie 1: one missed day erased your progress.

A streak at zero says a month of work is gone. It isn't. The counter reset, not you.
slides.alt: Card 1: one missed day didn't erase your progress; the counter reset, not you.

slides.text:
Lie 2: a red X means you failed.

A missed day is information, not an error. Look at the week, not the gap.
slides.alt: Card 2: a red X doesn't mean failure; look at the week, not the gap.

slides.text:
Lie 3: more habits means more progress.

Twelve habits on day one is a plan to quit by Friday. Start with *one*.
slides.alt: Card 3: twelve habits on day one is a plan to quit; start with one.

slides.text:
Lie 4: today is the only day that counts.

A daily view hides the trend. Five good days out of seven is a good week.
slides.alt: Card 4: a daily view hides the trend; five out of seven is a good week.

slides.text:
Lie 5: guilt is good motivation.

"Don't break your streak!" at 11pm works right up until you mute it.
slides.alt: Card 5: guilt notifications work until you mute them.

slides.text:
Lie 6: a perfect week is the goal.

The goal is still doing it in March. Consistent beats perfect.
slides.alt: Card 6: the goal is still doing it in March; consistent beats perfect.

slides.text: Send this to someone who deleted a habit app out of guilt.
